snippet.title: The Psalms of Summer
snippet.description:
'The Psalms of Summer' worship collective

These worship songs accompany our 'Psalms of Summer' sermon series. Each song is based on one of the books of Psalms. As David wrote songs to express his love for God and at times, his need for rescue and forgiveness, we also express our need for Him in our lives!

We pray that these songs help usher you into a deeper connection with God through His Holy Spirit.

snippet.title: The Sounds of Christmas
snippet.description: Jubilee Sounds of Christmas is a celebration of God's love for us. We are thankful for the gift that Jesus is to us all and sing his praises! Thank you for tuning in. To learn more about Jubilee Church, visit us on the web at www.jubileestl.org
